notes.title: Update v6.2
notes.notes:
Hi all,

a smaller update with the following fixes:


 Fixed missing german translation for "Front Door"
 Play music in credits even if music volume is set to 0.

Best

Kai

notes.title: Update V6.1
notes.notes:
Included fixes:
- UI scaling improved for higher screen resolutions (Player switch buttons)
- Removed "Professor Crackbrain_BackUpThisFolder" from games data folder, as it's not needed to be shipped
- Added some specific interactions (instead of default interactions) for some "use" inventory on hotspot
- Remote Car can't be used anymore in the dungeon, if the player is in the cell.
- Fixed a bug, where Rogy Hotspot was showing on the edge of the screen of the backyard, even when he's not in the scene.
- Playground cutscene can not be skipped anymore.

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hi all,

after 3 years of development the game is now finally feature complete.
What a journey it was. :-) Now I start an intensive testing phase.

The release data of the game I'm aiming for right now is the 2.12.2022.

Best,
Kai

notes.title: V 4.2 Demo release
notes.notes:
Hi all,

today I've released a new version of the demo. (V4.2)

Main features added:
- Fast travel: You can now ride the BMX, to travel fast between the lookout and Jay's house.

Hope you enjoy it!
Let me know in the comments what you think and if you find any bugs or issues.

Best
Kai

notes.title: V 4.0 Demo release
notes.notes:
Hi all,

today I've released a new version of the demo. (V4.0)

Main features added:
- Now you can toggle between full screen and windowed mode in the main menu.
- You can now name your savegames.

Other changes:
- Improved English localization
- Fix: When saving & loading savegames in the livingroom some states where not stored.
- Improved the size of some hotspots.

Hope you enjoy it!
Let me know in the comments what you think and if you find any bugs or issues.

Best
Kai

notes.title: New Update of the Demo (V3.5)
notes.notes:
Hi all,

I have release a new version of the Demo (V 3.5) with some improvements.

Here's the change log: 


 Limited FPS to 60 to avoid astronomic fps on fast systems
 Improved usability on Inventory / Closes if you click outside
 Improved usability of tutorial windows / modal to avoid overlay of windows
 Increased walk and run speed of the players.
 Main Menu shows now the version (Demo / Full) and version number
 Added some more specific reactions on use interactions
 Some GFX and animations improved


Thanks for playing the demo & your feedback so far and your support.

Best
Kai
